what.printed: A user-friendly alternative to conventional corner solutions is the SPACE CORNER. Full extensions use every inch of storage space available. (blum.com overview) ... the SPACE CORNER cabinet comes in all heights and widths and puts corner space to optimal use. Ergonomic full extensions ensure that you have easy access to all items. (publications.blum.com/2022/ep557/en/)
what.reading: a corner base cabinet whose rows are full-extension drawers that run diagonally out of the inner corner; each row has TWO front leaves, one per arm, meeting at the inner corner. Blum sells the kit in two generations: the FIXED corner front (the two leaves carried on 'corner front pieces' and 'corner rear fixing brackets', wooden drawers on MOVENTO or TANDEM with the T51.7601 locking devices, or TANDEMBOX with the ZSF sets) and SPACE CORNER with SYNCROMOTION (TANDEMBOX antaro, the Z33 sets), whose two standard fronts are hinged and SWING INWARD on opening so they clear the neighbouring fronts. CLAUDE.md T78 F7 describes 'ONE L-shaped front per row'; that is the FIXED generation. The owner decides which generation the engine models (see engineNotes).

engineNotes.frontDecision: CLAUDE.md T78 F7 wants ONE L-shaped front per drawer row. Blum's current SPACE CORNER (SYNCROMOTION, Z33) uses two hinged standard fronts that swing inward; the fixed L front is the earlier generation (T51.7601 wooden drawer, ZSF sets). Both are real Blum kits. The owner chooses; the data for both is above.
engineNotes.runnersPerArm: the fixed-front wooden-drawer kit runs ONE drawer on one pair of 769 runners set diagonally, not two boxes on two pairs; CLAUDE.md T78 F7's 'TWO boxes (one per arm) on the existing drawer machinery' is the engine's own construction and has no Blum source in this file. The runner ladder per arm depth stays the engine's (profile.hardware.runner.movento.nominalLadder).
engineNotes.widthLaw: cabinet width 900 to 1200 is Blum's recommendation, not a limit; the engine refuses nothing on it, it proposes (CLAUDE.md T78: 'proposal, never a block').
engineNotes.notRead: the 2024/2025 SPACE CORNER application page itself (its number, web code, cabinet width table and front dimensions), Blum's downloadable sample drawer and cabinet plans, the EU MOVENTO article for SPACE CORNER, any LEGRABOX pairing
